en.title: Elegy of the Star Burial and the Golden Cradle of Silence
en.premise: In a world where magic and order have vanished following the death of a god, a young man—the descendant of a former Holy Knight—embarks on a journey carrying a fragment of a broken holy sword. His goal is to perform a forbidden ritual to rewind the world's time at the 'Silent Cradle,' a legendary oasis located at the edge of the desert. However, his path is beset by grotesque monsters born from the god's corpse and a cult of nothingness seeking the world's total annihilation.

zh.title: 星葬挽歌与黄金静寂之摇篮
zh.premise: 在神明陨落、魔法与秩序随之失落的世界里，一名身为昔日圣骑士后裔的青年，携带着断裂圣剑的碎片踏上了旅程。他的目标是在沙漠尽头那座名为“静寂摇篮”的传说绿洲中，举行一场能够让世界时间倒流的禁忌仪式。然而，在这条旅途中，诞生于神之尸骸的异形怪物，以及企图让世界彻底毁灭的虚无教团，正阻挡在他的面前。
